column1: # labels.tsv for `larmor probe fit`: one row per scan, tab-separated, like a BIDS participants.tsv.
# Lines starting with '#' are comments; larmor skips them (and blank lines).
# scan    path to the scan, relative to this file (absolute paths also work). Required.
# fold    optional: a 0-based outer cross-validation fold per row. Leave the column out to get the
#         eval framework's folds (KFold(5, shuffle, seed 0) for regression and segmentation,
#         StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle, seed 0) for classification). Fold ids left without rows (all
#         their labels missing) are closed up: 0, 2, 3 become 0, 1, 2.
# others  label columns; pick one with --label. Empty cells and n/a are missing: rows without the
#         chosen label are left out of that fit.
#   larmor probe fit examples/labels.tsv --model nanobrain-vits-p8 --kind regression --label age --out age.toml
#   larmor probe fit examples/labels.tsv --model nanobrain-vits-p8 --kind classification --label group --out group.toml
#   larmor probe fit examples/labels.tsv --model nanobrain-vits-p8 --kind segmentation --label lesion --out lesion.toml
# regression      numbers (age).
# classification  exactly two values; numbers sort numerically, text alphabetically, and the second is
#                 the positive class (here: patient, the probability apply reports).
# segmentation    a binary (0/1) NIfTI per scan in the scan's own space (any grid: it is resampled onto
#                 the model grid with nearest neighbour, as eval/prepare.py does for segs).
# The header row is the first line that is not a comment.
